title: Clinical Validation of the Role of microRNA Binding Site Mutations in Cancer Risk, Prevention and Treatment
official: Clinical Validation of the Role of microRNA Binding Site Mutations in Cancer Risk, Prevention and Treatment
summary: The investigators will recruit and enroll individuals that may have the KRAS-variant or other microRNA binding site mutations to join registry studies. The investigators will allow individuals to obtain their results through a physician at the completion of the studies. The investigators current focus is cancer and autoimmunity.

interventions.name: KRAS-variant and microRNA binding site mutation testing

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Personal or family history of cancer
* Personal history of endometriosis, or autoimmunity

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18
* Non-english speaking and unable to understand and sign the consent
